creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Agents read the SessionStart line about `report --waiting` as covering a wait for a message, declare it, and then show `waiting` rather than `idle`, so a director's `muster pane wait --until idle` on them never ends. The line, from extras/claude-code/hooks/hooks.json and extras/codex/hooks/hooks.json, is: In Muster: if you end a turn to wait on work you started, first run "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --waiting "". ## Measured: 2026-10-05, devenv, convening a directed council The director started three agents with the first prompt "run `muster msg join --name X`, then end your turn; your brief arrives as a message", then ran `muster pane wait --pane

--until idle,blocked --timeout 400` on each before `group add`. All three ran `"$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --waiting "brief from muster msg"` before ending their turn. `muster window` showed them `waiting`, and the first wait timed out (exit 5) after 400 s with that agent at its prompt, waiting only for a message. ## Things that might be true - **Say in the hook line that waiting for a message or a person is just ending the turn**, and that only work the agent started (a build, a background job, a sub-agent) is a wait to report. - Or treat a waiting reason that names `muster msg` as idle. - Or let a `pane wait` caller count `waiting` as met when it asks to.
title: ⏳ Agents declare waiting for a message, so pane wait --until idle times out
